text: Long catch-up with Heather over lunch. Her daughter Mabel starts reception sometime in September and Heather's already dreading the uniform shopping. Mabel is apparently fine about it. I should text Heather that morning, she'll be a wreck at the gate.
Jakub lives in Leith now, moved in with his partner Rosa last spring. He's still at the brewery, she teaches piano from home. Two cats, Pickle and Biscuit.
Rohan graduates from Leeds early July, ceremony in the afternoon and a meal with his parents the day before. Need to get him a card before end of June.

Quick call with Imani. Her son Kieran sits his GCSEs over the summer and he's properly stressed, not sleeping much. She's thinking of booking a little break for them afterwards. Ask her how he's doing sometime next week.
Emeka works for the council planning dept, been there about ten years. Wife is Ciara, Irish, from Galway. Two boys, both at St Joseph's.
Niamh's graduation was Thursday. Must send her congrats, totally forgot on the day.

Coffee with Asha and Nikhil. They're moving to Bristol sometime in the new year, Nikhil's got a transfer with work. Asha's nervous about leaving her mum, who's not been well. Asha said her mum has a hospital appointment early March and she wants to be around for that before they go. I'm helping them pack the weekend before the move.
Yetunde mentioned her little one Ali lost his first tooth last night. Massive drama apparently. He's six.
Pick up dry cleaning, renew car tax by end of the month.
Carlos and Marisol's anniversary dinner on the 14th is cancelled, Marisol's dad is in hospital. Check in with her at the weekend.
Ellie's starting a PGCE after Christmas. She works part time at the library till then. Her brother Sam is doing his finals in May, also wants to teach eventually.
Ran into Mrs Kaur at the shop. Her granddaughter Hana passed her driving test first time last week! Hana's off to uni in Glasgow in the autumn.

Talked to Beatriz Santos on the phone. She's back in Lisbon for a bit, mum had a fall. Doesn't know when she's coming back, maybe end of November. Anders is holding the fort at home with the dog, a big lab called Bruno. Remind me to message Beatriz the day after her mum's scan, which is sometime next week.
Shanice: works at the vet's on Holloway Road, lives in Finsbury Park with her sister Angela. Angela's a nurse at the Whittington. Shanice loves climbing, goes most weekends.
Rory's son Jun had his first day at nursery today. Cried for ten minutes then forgot all about it. Rory was worse than Jun.

Dinner at Zhang's. His wife Bao is expecting, due sometime in April. They're doing the nursery up over Easter. Zhang's mum is flying over from Shanghai a week after the baby arrives and staying the whole summer. Zhang very calm about it all, Bao less so about the mother-in-law! Get them something for the baby, maybe a nice sling.
Seo-yeon got into the Royal College! Starts in September. Her parents are over the moon. Ask what she wants for a present, she hinted at a new music stand.
Zeynep's Turkish, lives in Hackney, works in UX at a fintech. Married to Natasha, who's a GP. No kids, one very fat cat called Lokum.
Heather said Mabel's school play is the last week of term, she's a sheep. Heather's working that day and gutted. I'm going along with Mabel's grandad instead.
Kieran's results come out mid August. Don't forget to message Imani that morning, and maybe pop round with a cake the next day if it's good news.

Call with Niamh O'Brien. She's settled in Cork, working remotely for the same agency. Her partner Rohan is retraining as an electrician, college course starts sometime in January. They've finally got a garden. Niamh said the commute was killing her before so this suits her much better.
Jakub's mum turns 70 at the end of the month. He's organising a surprise lunch, wants me to help with the cake. I'm baking it the day before.
Note to self: dentist sometime next week, book it.
Asha said Nikhil's sister Yetunde is getting married over the summer, probably late July. Asha's a bridesmaid and already panicking about the speech.
Emeka's eldest, Ali, has his 11+ exam in early September. He's been doing tutoring all year. Emeka seems more worried than Ali is. Text Emeka good luck the night before.
Marisol works at the hospital pharmacy. Carlos is a chef, runs the kitchen at that tapas place on the high street. Their daughter Rosa is at secondary now, year 8, mad about horses.

Bumped into Anders outside Tesco. Beatriz is back from Lisbon, her mum's recovering well. He said they're thinking of going back out there in the spring for a proper holiday. Ask Beatriz how her mum is.
Ciara said her mum's 80th is sometime after Christmas, family are doing a big do in Galway. Ciara wants to fly over a few days before to help set up.
Ellie had her interview for the PGCE yesterday, thinks it went ok but not sure. Hears back sometime next week. Need to ask how it went.
Hana Le is Mrs Kaur's granddaughter, the one who's off to Glasgow. Studying vet medicine. Lives with her gran during the week, parents are in Leicester.
Rory and his wife are doing a parents' evening for Jun's nursery on Tuesday. Jun's apparently the biggest biter in his room. Rory mortified.
Shanice's climbing comp is early March. She's been training like mad, fingers all taped up. Wish her luck the day before, she gets really nervous before these.

Big catch-up with the old uni lot. Natasha's going part time from the new year to look after her dad, he was diagnosed with Parkinson's in the summer. Zeynep's job is going well, she's up for a promotion end of the month. Kieran (Natasha's cousin, not Imani's lad) is moving to Manchester sometime soon. Nobody quite sure when. Must call Natasha next week, she sounded exhausted.
Seo-yeon's leaving recital is the Friday before she goes. Her teacher Mr Petrov is organising it. Get flowers to give her afterwards.
Zhang said Bao's baby shower is off, she's on bed rest. Don't forget to text Bao, see how she's holding up.
Imani lives just off Lordship Lane. Her husband is a firefighter. Kieran is their only one, 16.
Mabel's 5th birthday party is the weekend after she starts school. Heather says she's obsessed with dinosaurs, anything dino would go down well.

Rohan's graduation went brilliantly, his dad cried the whole way through. He's starting a grad scheme at an engineering firm in Sheffield sometime in September. Rohan seems a bit nervous about moving away from home for the first time, and his girlfriend Ellie is staying in Leeds for her masters. Send him a message the week after he starts to see how he's getting on.
Asha and Nikhil's leaving drinks are end of the month. I'm doing a card for everyone to sign.
Yetunde's at Barclays, mortgage advisor, been there forever. Lives in Croydon. Ali's dad isn't around, it's just the two of them and her mum.
Got to sort the boiler service before winter. And cancel the gym.

Jakub mentioned Rosa's been struggling since she lost her job in the summer. She's applying for loads but nothing yet. She's got an interview sometime next week for a school music job. Ring Rosa afterwards.
Nikhil starts the Bristol job in early February. His first day is a Monday, the move is the weekend before. Asha's mum is coming to stay a few days after they arrive to help unpack.
Uncle Emeka's 60th birthday is in the spring, maybe April. Ciara wants to do a surprise trip to Lagos. Keep it quiet.
Angela passed her nursing exams! Graduation in the autumn sometime. Shanice is so proud. Must send Angela congratulations.

Catch-up with Marisol. Her dad's out of hospital and home now, recovering slowly. Carlos has been doing all the school runs. They're rebooking the anniversary dinner for sometime next month. Rosa's got her first riding competition over half term, she's been practising every weekend and is beside herself with nerves. Marisol joked she'd rather do it herself.
Kieran's prom is the end of June, the week after his last exam. Imani's already bought her outfit, ha.
Zeynep got the promotion! Head of design now. Natasha says she's barely sleeping though, new team is a lot.
Bea (Beatriz) said Anders is training for the Lisbon half marathon in early October. He's never done one before. Flight out is the Thursday before.
Jun turns three on Saturday. Rory's doing a little party at soft play. Jun's into trains, Thomas especially. Buy a present Friday.
Ellie got onto the PGCE! Starts after Christmas. Her mum's throwing her a little dinner sometime next week.
Natasha said her dad's next appointment with the neurologist is early December. She's taking him. Remind me to check in with her that evening.
Ciara and Emeka bought a house in Bromley, completing end of the month. Housewarming sometime in the spring once they've unpacked. Their boys are staying at St Joseph's, so it's a longer school run.
Hana's moving into halls on the 20th of September, freshers' week straight after. Mrs Kaur is driving her up the day before. Mrs Kaur is quite emotional about it.
Quick text from Rohan, settling in at work, likes Sheffield. Ellie's visiting him at the weekend.
Mr Petrov teaches violin at the conservatoire and lives near Seo-yeon's family in Barnet. Wife's a translator, Russian and English.

Spent the afternoon with Heather and Mabel. Mabel's first week at school went fine, she's made a friend called Hana. Heather's going back to work full time from November, at the same accountancy firm. Her husband's sorting childcare with his parents.
Need to finish the photo album for Mum before Christmas.
Sam (Ellie's brother) finished his finals today, said the last paper was brutal. Results end of June. Ask him how he feels about it next time.

Jakub and Rosa are heading to Poland over Christmas to see his family, back sometime after New Year. Rosa's nervous about meeting his grandma for the first time. Rosa got the school music job by the way, starts in January. Should send her a good luck message the day before she starts.
